hasil.hook: Whatever you do, don't look at your clock at 3:00 AM.

naskah.narasi: The digital display freezes at 2:59. The seconds stop... but the darkness around you starts moving.

naskah.narasi: You hear heavy breathing right behind your left ear, but your body refuses to turn around.

naskah.narasi: You try to scream, but your voice is trapped. Something invisible is stealing seconds directly from your life.

naskah.narasi: Have you ever felt time freeze at night... or were you just taken?

shot.visual: Close-up dramatis jam digital merah di nakas kamar tidur gelap, pencahayaan low-key dengan vignette pekat mengitari frame.
shot.animasi_teks: Efek Glitch 1 / Chromatic Aberration (durasi in 0.5s, shake subtle loop sampai detik 3).
shot.sfx: SFX detak jarum jam mekanik cepat mendadak berhenti tiba-tiba + low frequency drone glitch.

shot.visual: Layar jam digital membeku di angka '2:59', kabut hitam pekat mulai merayap keluar dari sudut lantai kamar tidur.
shot.animasi_teks: Typewriter II dengan jitter getar horizontal (durasi ketik 1.2s, subtle float hingga detik 8.5 lalu fade out 0.3s).
shot.sfx: SFX suara hening mekanis mendadak (deep vacuum woosh) diikuti ambient room tone berat dan eerie whisper samar.

shot.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot karakter kaku menghadap dinding, bayangan hitam tak berbentuk mendekat tepat ke sisi kiri kepalanya.
shot.animasi_teks: Blur-to-Clear Smooth (Gaussian Blur in 0.8s, scale up perlahan 10% selama 5s).
shot.sfx: Audio 3D Panning: SFX hembusan napas berat lembap keras tepat di telinga kiri (hard left ear).

shot.visual: Extreme close-up pupil mata karakter melebar ketakutan, urat leher tegang berusaha membuka mulut namun tubuh lumpuh total.
shot.animasi_teks: Pulse Glow Merah (Pulse scale in-out 0.6s per siklus, efek neon intensitas naik-turun).
shot.transisi: Whip Pan Left dengan motion blur cepat (0.3s)
shot.sfx: SFX detak jantung teredam (muffled heartbeat) berpacu kencang + riser frekuensi tinggi yang makin memekakkan telinga.

shot.visual: Angka jam melompat ke '3:01'. Karakter menghela napas lega, namun bayangan di dinding berdiri terpisah dan menoleh menatap tajam ke arah kamera.
shot.animasi_teks: Crash Zoom In Distorsi (0.3s snap zoom) disertai efek RGB Split Flicker berulang.
shot.transisi: Flash White to Negative Color Invert (0.2s)
shot.sfx: SFX Jumpscare sting logam menusuk (metallic drone screech) + tawa bisikan dingin bernada rendah.

shot.visual: Frame perlahan tersedot ke dalam kegelapan total, menyisakan siluet ruangan kosong yang dingin dan mencekam.
shot.animasi_teks: Slow Dissolve Fade In (1.0s), teks melayang naik pelan (drift up), diakhiri Fade Out halus ke hitam (1.2s).
shot.sfx: SFX Sub-bass rumble yang meluruh perlahan (decay panjang) menuju dead silence (hening total).

hasil.musik: Dark Cinematic Horror Ambience / Sub-bass Tension Drone (Tempo lambat 60 BPM, instrumen cello disonan dan synth gelap, build-up tajam di detik 16-25, meluruh perlahan di detik 32-40).
hasil.safe_area: Format 9:16 vertikal (TikTok/Reels/Shorts). Margin aman: 10% atas, 15% bawah (hindari tombol like/comment dan deskripsi platform), 8% kiri-kanan. Teks utama ditaruh di tengah vertikal (Y: 45%-55%).
hasil.by_agung: Top-Center (Y: 5% dari tepi atas), font Montserrat/Inter Regular, ukuran 24pt, warna putih opacity 70%, statis sepanjang video tanpa efek animasi.

hasil.hook: In 1912, an ocean liner vanished into thin air... but the ocean never let it die.

naskah.narasi: In 1912, an ocean liner vanished into thin air... but the ocean never let it die.
naskah.teks_layar:
[TOP FRAME - FADE IN] by Agung
[GLITCH ANIMATION] Vanished in 1912...

naskah.narasi: No distress call was sent. No debris ever surfaced. Just a thick, freezing fog that swallowed two hundred souls whole.
naskah.teks_layar:
[TOP FRAME - STATIC] by Agung
[TYPEWRITER ANIMATION] No Distress Call.
No Debris.

naskah.narasi: Decades later, static on dead radio frequencies began repeating her name... always at precisely 3:15 AM.
naskah.teks_layar:
[TOP FRAME - STATIC] by Agung
[PULSE & GLOW ANIMATION] 3:15 AM Signals Echoing...

naskah.narasi: Modern captains still report a rusted, unlit hull slicing through modern shipping lanes during severe storms.
naskah.teks_layar:
[TOP FRAME - STATIC] by Agung
[DRIFT & FADE ANIMATION] Sightings in the Storm

naskah.narasi: Instruments die. Temperatures plunge to zero. And the sound of heavy footsteps echoes on empty iron decks.
naskah.teks_layar:
[TOP FRAME - STATIC] by Agung
[ZOOM & FLICKER ANIMATION] Footsteps on Empty Decks...

naskah.narasi: If you saw a ghost ship emerging from the mist... would you stop to help, or sail away as fast as you could?
naskah.teks_layar:
[TOP FRAME - FADE OUT] by Agung
[SLOW REVEAL & SHAKE ANIMATION] Would you stop to help?

hasil.cta: Would you stop to help, or sail away as fast as you could?
